conditional_reference_comparison.qualification: Ratios apply only if this motor model is confirmed. Rated current is not a measured RMS waveform for all operating conditions. This is not a new thermal pass. Sustained stall cannot use the TB6612 single10ms absolute pulse entry as an operating permission.

confirmed_existing_values.Q1_permission: LOGIC_GOOD through R3,Q2,R2; independent of VM_OK/ARM
confirmed_existing_values.source_to_VM: J1 -> F1 -> D1 -> Q1 -> VM; no 12V-to-6V regulator

definitive_incompatibilities.finding: SMBJ7.0A shunts a directly 12V-fed VM rail into avalanche; it is not a continuous-voltage regulator. Sustained power depends on source impedance and protection, not its600W pulse label.
Existing OV threshold~7.16V rejects a normal12V-class VM rail; VM_OK inhibits arm but does not open Q1.
definitive_incompatibilities.classification: incompatible settings and inadequate remedy for D2 fault

definitive_incompatibilities.finding: Direct12V input exceeds the accepted5.5–6.5V reference envelope; D1/Q1 are not a voltage regulator.

conditional_TB6612_evaluation.result: NOT APPROVED; nominal12V alone neither proves suitability nor proves bare-IC voltage incompatibility
requirements: actual VM including charge maximum, ripple and regeneration stays inside reviewed operating envelope with margin
